paris.seoDescription: How the City of Paris brought AI services into its citizen portal with Meecrogate, cutting integration time by 40%.
paris.heroTitle: AI citizen portal - City of Paris
paris.heroSubtitle: Speeding up digital innovation for the people of Paris
paris.contextText: The City of Paris wanted to enrich its citizen portal with advanced artificial intelligence services: a conversational chatbot, real-time translation, personalised recommendations and predictive analysis tools. The goal was to markedly improve the experience of Paris residents while meeting demands for fast deployment, data security and digital sovereignty.
paris.contextQuote: Our vision was to make Paris the first European capital to show that AI services can be brought into public administration quickly and securely.
paris.contextQuoteAuthor: - Director of Digital Innovation, City of Paris

challenges.title: Integration complexity
challenges.description: Each AI service called for bespoke development taking several months, with a risk of technological fragmentation.

challenges.title: Digital sovereignty
challenges.description: Citizen data had to stay under control, hosted in France, with absolute GDPR compliance.

challenges.title: The agility required
challenges.description: The city needed to connect or disconnect an API in a few clicks, and to automate security and monitoring.

challenges.title: Vendor dependency
challenges.description: Existing solutions carried a risk of technological lock-in and of regulatory non-compliance.

solutions.title: Plug-and-play integration
solutions.description: A stateless architecture that lets new AI services be integrated quickly, without changing the existing system.

solutions.title: Full automation
solutions.description: Automatic cataloguing, security management and real-time monitoring of every integrated API.

solutions.title: Guaranteed sovereignty
solutions.description: Data kept under control and hosted in France, with native GDPR compliance and security certification.

solutions.title: Express deployment
solutions.description: Fully in place in a matter of weeks, against several months with traditional solutions.
